task_info.original_instruction:
Check the inbox for crm.assistant@company.com for an email thread containing customer feedback from Rachel Kim.

Then:
1. Find the target contact in the CRM
2. Create a Note in the CRM linked to the contact with:
   - Subject: "Demo Feedback - Sunrise Ventures"
   - Description: Summary of the customer's feedback including sentiment, feature comments, and any outstanding questions
3. Update the contact's description field to include: "Demo feedback received - [sentiment]"
4. Send a follow-up email to Rachel (rachel.kim@sunriseventures.com) acknowledging her feedback and addressing her questions. The email body must include the phrase: "Your feedback has been recorded and our team will follow up on your questions shortly"

tool_params.body:
Dear Rachel,

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback following yesterday's product demo. We truly appreciate you and your team taking the time to evaluate our platform.

We're thrilled to hear that your team was impressed with our real-time collaboration tools, dashboard customization options, and mobile app responsiveness. These are indeed core strengths of our platform.

Regarding your questions:

1. **Implementation Timeline**: For a company of 150 employees, typical implementation ranges from 6-12 weeks depending on complexity and customization requirements. Our team will provide a detailed timeline during the scoping phase.

2. **Dedicated Onboarding Support**: Yes, we offer comprehensive onboarding support including dedicated success managers, training sessions for your team, and ongoing support during the initial adoption period.

3. **Trial Period**: We certainly understand the importance of evaluating the platform before committing. We can arrange a customized trial period tailored to your specific use cases and requirements.

Your feedback has been recorded and our team will follow up on your questions shortly. I'll also be connecting with our integration specialists to provide more details on the Salesforce integration process and data migration approaches that worked well for similar-sized organizations.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any additional questions in the meantime. We're excited about the possibility of working with Sunrise Ventures.

Best regards,

CRM Assistant
Company Team
